text: What if your captions and translations never needed the internet?
ConferenceCaptioning runs its A.I. on a device in the room. No data center, and your audio stays on site.
Put captions and translations under your slides, like live T.V., in more than fifty languages.
Send translated audio to headsets in about a second, and plug into the A.V. tools you already use.
Visit our booth, and let's brainstorm what offline A.I. can do for your next event.
